title: OutlookConversationWarning
description: A part of a conversation that could not be represented fully, without hiding the rest.

code.description: Stable machine-readable warning code. Known values include truncated, attachment_unavailable, embedded_attachments_omitted, body_preview_only, body_unavailable, body_truncated, and unsupported_source. body_preview_only means the message's body is only the preview its application cached. unsupported_source means the mailbox's store cannot be read as conversations at all: the result has no messages and retrying cannot help.

internetMessageId.description: The message the warning is about, when it is message-scoped.
